citations.quote:
[name="莱欧斯"]这里就是那位女士说的训练室了吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4141_marcil_1#14$1",focus="m")]
[name="玛露西尔"]这里好像没什么人……那边倒是有一个好大的怪东西……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]你们还愣着干什么？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4142_laios_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莱欧斯"]欸，大祭司？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4141_marcil_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="玛露西尔"]大祭司，你有见到刻俄柏吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]她刚才还在这里，不过已经跑走了。
[name="大祭司"]你们想见到那个小家伙？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4141_marcil_1#17$1",focus="m")]
[name="玛露西尔"]嗯！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]那就别磨蹭了，赶紧都过来，坐进这台机器里！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4142_laios_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莱欧斯"]欸？啊……好、好吧。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement",volume=1)]
[charslot(duration=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_012",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="近卫干员"]大祭司，我们得到消息，好像有走失的访客往这边来了，你有见到吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]什么？我没见过，我们正在这边做新型号大丑的抗冲击安全测试。
[name="大祭司"]建议你们离远一点。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_012",focus="m")]
[name="近卫干员"]呃……好。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]搞定，祖玛玛，准备就绪！
[Character(name="char_416_zumama_1")]
[name="森蚺"]你确定？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]当然。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[stopmusic(fadetime=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$shotgunreload",volume=1)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_explo_n",volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, ystrength=50, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[Delay(time=2.5)]
[name="驾驶舱内的莱欧斯小队"]啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_012",focus="m")]
[name="近卫干员"]我怎么好像看到里面有人被炸飞了……
[playMusic(intro="$dontmaketrouble_intro", key="$dontmaketrouble_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]你确定你看到有人被炸飞了吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_012",focus="m")]
[name="近卫干员"]咦……消失了？
[name="近卫干员"]难道我真的看错了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]行了，去别的地方找吧，你要找的人不在这。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_012",focus="m")]
[name="近卫干员"]好吧。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Character(name="char_416_zumama_1")]
[name="森蚺"]你这完全是公报私仇。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]他们炖了我一次，我炸他们一次，也算是礼尚往来吧。
[Character(name="char_416_zumama_1")]
[name="森蚺"]你把他们弄哪里去了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1429_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="大祭司"]他们想要找刻俄柏，我就送他们去找刻俄柏。
[name="大祭司"]这可没有骗他们。

contributions.description: 森蚺与苦根共同处于训练室近旁连续场景。
